network.strava.title: Strava
network.strava.sends: Sends: only an activity you choose to upload, when you tap Upload: its start and end, its type and name, the band's heart rate during it and its GPS route without the first and last 200 m (unless you turn that off for that upload). Connecting also sends your own Strava app's client ID and secret and the sign-in tokens.
network.strava.to: To: Strava (www.strava.com), under Strava's privacy policy, into your own Strava account. Nothing is sent in the background.
strava.title: Strava
strava.intro: Upload the activities you choose to your own Strava account. OpenHoop never reads anything from Strava and sends nothing until you tap Upload on an activity.
strava.networkOff: Turn on Network features and Strava under Privacy first. Until then OpenHoop cannot reach Strava.
strava.setupBody: Strava has no secure sign-in for apps without a server, so every OpenHoop user registers a free Strava app of their own. It takes a minute:
strava.setupStep1: 1. Open strava.com/settings/api and create an app. Any name, category and website work.
strava.setupStep2: 2. Set Authorization Callback Domain to: localhost
strava.setupStep3: 3. Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from that page into the fields below.
strava.clientHint: Kept only in this phone's secure storage. Never in the database, the export or a log.
strava.clientInvalid: That does not look like a Strava Client ID (digits) and Client Secret (letters and digits).
strava.clientSaved: App details saved on this phone.
strava.connectBody: Strava opens in a browser. OpenHoop asks only to upload activities (activity:write). It cannot read your Strava activities, profile or followers.
strava.reconnectBody: Strava no longer accepts OpenHoop's sign-in, for example because access was removed on strava.com. Connect again to upload.
strava.disconnectBody: OpenHoop asks Strava to revoke its access, then removes the app details and sign-in tokens from this phone. Activities already on Strava stay there.
strava.revokeFailed: Removed from this phone, but OpenHoop could not reach Strava to revoke access. Remove the app under strava.com/settings/apps.
strava.error.network-off: Network features or Strava is off under Privacy.
strava.error.no-client: Save your Strava app's Client ID and Client Secret first.
strava.error.invalid-client: Strava did not accept the Client ID, Client Secret or sign-in. Check the app details and that Authorization Callback Domain is localhost.
strava.error.reconnect: Strava no longer accepts OpenHoop's sign-in. Connect again under Settings, Integrations, Strava.
strava.error.cancelled: Sign-in was closed before it finished.
strava.error.denied: You did not allow OpenHoop on Strava.
strava.error.state-mismatch: The answer from Strava did not belong to this sign-in, so OpenHoop ignored it. Try again.
strava.error.scope-missing: Strava did not grant permission to upload activities. Connect again and keep "Upload your activities" ticked.
strava.error.unauthorized: Strava refused the sign-in. Connect again.
strava.error.rate-limited: Strava's request limit for your app is used up. Try again in 15 minutes, or tomorrow if the daily limit is reached.
strava.error.duplicate: Strava already has this activity, so it kept the existing one. OpenHoop will not upload it again.
strava.error.already-uploaded: This activity is already on Strava.
strava.error.maybe-sent: Strava did not answer, so this activity may already be on Strava. Check your Strava feed before you upload it again.
strava.error.rejected: Strava did not accept this upload.
strava.error.processing-failed: Strava could not process the file. Nothing was added to Strava, so you can try again.
strava.error.deleted: The activity was deleted on Strava. You can upload it again.
strava.error.server: Strava has a problem right now. Try again later.
strava.error.invalid-response: Strava sent an answer OpenHoop does not understand.
strava.error.timeout: Strava took too long to answer.
strava.error.network: Could not reach Strava. Check your connection.
strava.error.storage: Could not read or save the Strava details on this phone.
strava.upload.title: Upload to Strava
strava.upload.sends: This sends to your Strava account: start {start}, {duration}, type {type}, the name "{name}".
strava.upload.heartRate: Heart rate from the band: {count} samples during the activity.
strava.upload.noHeartRate: No band heart rate during this activity.
strava.upload.hidden: The first and last 200 m of the route are left out, as everywhere OpenHoop shows a route.
strava.upload.hideEnds: Leave out the first and last 200 m
strava.upload.hiddenAll: The route is shorter than 400 m, so with the ends left out no GPS is sent.
strava.upload.manual: Without heart rate or route there is no file to upload, so OpenHoop creates a manual Strava entry with just the start, duration, type and name.
strava.upload.connectFirst: Connect Strava under Settings, Integrations to upload.
